title: Learning Planner output
description: Doc 17 section 7. Harness rules: every proposed concept and edge is proposed and never applied, so nothing here writes a confirmed row; the number of new concepts is at most the packet's max_new_concepts; every term in proposed_edges is either on the map or in proposed_concepts; frontier and level come from the deterministic rules rather than from a model, and an output that names them differently is overwritten rather than trusted.

proposed_concepts.description: Doc 17 section 7: decomposition of a new topic, constrained to the concepts on the map plus at most three new ones. Proposed, never applied: doc 01 section 4.10's rule is that an agent proposes and a person confirms.

why.description: One line the learner reads before confirming.

frontier.description: Doc 17 section 3: the lowest prerequisite level where a rated concept is still unverified. Computed by the rule, carried here so the event and the Map read one answer.
